DitherGauge.label: What is measured. Shown under the value and used as the accessible name.
DitherGauge.minimum: The low end of the scale.
DitherGauge.maximum: The high end of the scale.
DitherGauge.variant: half (180°), dial (270°, like a speedometer) or ring (a full circle from the top).
DitherGauge.segments: Number of blocks the arc is split into. The default depends on the variant.
DitherGauge.unit: Shown after the value, such as "%" or " ms".
DitherGauge.decimals: Most decimals in the value and the range.
DitherGauge.value-text: Text for the reading, instead of the value and unit.
DitherGauge.show-range: Shows minimum and maximum under the ends of the arc.
DitherGauge.track-color: Colour of the empty track, drawn faint.
DitherGauge.fill: gradient (each block behind the value a step lighter), dotted, hatched or solid. The block at the value is always solid.
DitherGauge.bloom: low or high adds a glow behind the filled blocks.
DitherGauge.animate: Fades the blocks in one by one when the gauge appears.
